name: Nav Probe (research)
description: Research for Koleda's Sinner: tries the navigation queries CowboyBingus recorded. F8 finds the closest navmesh point where you stand and ahead of you, Ctrl+F8 sends the nearest enemy to where you stand, Alt+F8 runs the stratagem ball's on-navmesh check, Shift+F8 logs the code and every navigation record. Each address is checked before use. Turn off when done.
